svg.title: Every reading the specimen's two attention heads made while it learned.
svg.desc: The corpus "to be or not to be" lies along the baseline (value ticks mark letters, gaps mark spaces). Reader i reading source j < i with weight A[i,j] is an arc from j to i of height span × weight; head 1 above the line, head 2 below. 40 moments of training (lr 1e-2, 20 warmup steps, cosine to 1e-4, clip 1, seed 0), later moments inked more strongly. Head 1 learns short, local readings; head 2 learns to reach far back.
